svg.title: DUAL-SURFACE GSLIVE MODEL — BATCH ACCOUNT REPORT vs LIVE BET-HISTORY STREAM
svg.desc: Reference model for the two GSLive Partner 118 surfaces and the rule that keeps them from double-counting. The batch surface #/reports/users returns one settled account row per player_[login] per desk day (handle, win/loss, wager count) and is authoritative for booked volume. The live surface #/events/bet-history pushes one event per wager state change, where betTime is the placement wall clock and calcTime is the grade/settle clock, and is authoritative for in-flight exposure and placement velocity. Both are bucketed into the America/Chicago desk day (00:00:00.000-23:59:59.999 CT), joined on (partnerId, login, ticketNumber, betTime), and refreshed with a `t` cache-buster tick (Math.floor(Date.now()/60000)) so a batch re-fetch never serves a stale edge copy and never disturbs the stream.

svg.text: DUAL-SURFACE GSLIVE MODEL — BATCH ACCOUNT REPORT vs LIVE BET-HISTORY STREAM
GSLive Manager Partner 118: #/reports/users (batch) • #/events/bet-history (live) • desk-day window • betTime vs calcTime • `t` cache-buster tick • ID: SD-ARTIFACT-04-DUAL-SURFACE-GSLIVE
SURFACE A — #/reports/users (BATCH)
Pull model: one settled row per player_[login] per desk day
🔗 Endpoint & Query Contract
GET /manager-tools/#/reports/users?partnerId=118
&text=player_MJ102&dateFrom=2026-10-25&dateTo=2026-10-31
dateFrom/dateTo are desk-day dates (YYYY-MM-DD, CT)
text= is a substring filter, not an exact login match
→ always confirm the returned login == requested login
📄 Payload Shape (account × day)
{ login, agentLogin, wagerCount,
handleCents, winLossCents, settledAt }
Settled-only: a row appears after the day closes
Authoritative for booked handle & settled net
No per-bet timestamps and no open-ticket rows
⏱ Cadence & Cache Posture
Refresh on portal open + scheduled desk cron
Edge and browser both cache the GET response
A plain re-fetch can return yesterday's totals
Batch is pull-only: no push, no invalidation signal
→ pair every batch call with a `t` cache-buster
⚠️ Batch-Only Failure Modes
• Refetch before cutoff → previous desk-day totals
• dateFrom > dateTo → silent empty rows, not an error
• substring `text=` filter → neighbouring logins leak in
• T+N grade lag → settledAt lands after the report day
Never size live liability or velocity from this surface
Batch answers "what closed?" — not "what is open now?"
Gate: reject rows whose login != requested player_ login
DESK-DAY WINDOW & `t` CACHE-BUSTER
One shared clock so batch and stream agree on "today"
🗓 Desk-Day Window (America/Chicago)
CDT = UTC−5 • CST = UTC−6 (DST follows CT)
week = Mon 00:00 CT → Sun 23:59:59.999 CT
Batch dateFrom/dateTo are CT calendar dates
Convert every stream timestamp to CT before bucketing
Never bucket on UTC midnight — it splits the desk day
⏱ betTime vs calcTime — Two Questions
betTime = placement wall clock (who bet, when)
calcTime = grade/settle clock (when the book posted)
Δ = calcTime − betTime
Live: Δ ≈ 0s • Pre-match: seconds • T+N: hours/days
calcTime may be null while the ticket is still open
→ open ticket: count exposure, never count settled net
🔁 The `t` Cache-Buster Tick
…&text=player_MJ102&t=1761912000
t = Math.floor(Date.now() / 60000)
60s bucket → stable within a minute, fresh across minutes
Busts edge + browser cache on the batch GET only
The stream is untouched: no reconnect, no replay gap
t must never enter the join key or the desk-day bucket
✅ Allocation Rule (one desk day, one owner)
betTime ↦ desk day of placement (velocity, count)
calcTime ↦ desk day of settlement (handle, win/loss)
A settle never rewrites the placement day's report
Late calcTime ⇒ moves to tomorrow's batch, not today's
Same rule for teasers and parlays: one parent, one day
SURFACE B — #/events/bet-history (LIVE)
Push model: one event per wager state change
⚡ Stream Contract
WS/SSE: placed → line-changed → graded → settled
{ ticketNumber, login, betTime, calcTime,
stakeCents, toWinCents, wagerStatus }
calcTime is empty while the bet is in flight
Reconnect must replay from the last seen betTime
🔗 Join Key & Precedence
key = (partnerId, login, ticketNumber, betTime)
Settled totals on conflict → batch wins (report of record)
Open / in-flight on conflict → stream wins (not booked yet)
Never SUM batch + stream for the same ticketNumber
Stream row with calcTime set and a batch row present ⇒
keep the batch row, drop the stream row (settled once)
🧮 Daily Reconciliation Loop
Σ stream settled(calcTime ∈ desk day)
== batch.handleCents for the same desk day
Explained diffs: T+N grade lag, ledger adjustments
Unresolved gap must be $0.00 before settlement
Unexplained Σ ⇒ replay the stream, then re-pull batch
Re-pull always carries a new `t` — never the old URL
🛠 Operator Surfaces
Batch: #/reports/users?partnerId=118&text=player_[login]
Live: #/events/bet-history (stream)
./bin/dx gslive • ./bin/dx modes 7 • ./bin/dx modes 9
./bin/dx modes 10 verifies batch == stream for the day
⚡ OPERATOR CLI & LIVE LINKS: ./bin/dx gslive | ./bin/dx modes 7 | ./bin/dx modes 9 | ./bin/dx modes 10 → https://pub-d061f943df0e4477ba7ff200721eddb1.r2.dev/graph.html
